page.layout: One page of text; a marginal note in the left margin beside the paragraph "XVI. Amen". Running head at top. Below the text: a title block in capitals, a printed ornament (engraving, not transcribed), and the word INDEX at the lower right, which is a catchword-like mark set apart in its own block.

main_text.l: & quod ei pretium addit. Post consummationem seculorum omni bono-
rum abundantia ita in coelis satiabimur, nihil ut amplius desiderandum su-
perfit. Hoc unum ex omni precatione remanebit, Ei qui insidet throno,

l.i: & Agno, sit benedictio & honor, & gloria, & robur in secula seculorum.

main_text.l: XVI. AMEN Hebraeis particula est & asseverantis, & valide aliquid op-
tantis, Dixit Jeremias Propheta, Amen, ita faciat Jehova. Jer. xxviii:
6. Declaramus ergo hac voce, & sinceritatem professionis nostrae de Dei
regno, potentia, & gloria: & magnitudinem desiderii nostri, quo tanta
a Deo bona expetimus; & fidem nixam promissionibus Dei, non in cas-
sum nos orare quaecunque secundum voluntatem ejus oramus. Animose,
ut solet Melanchtoni scribebat olim Lutherus: Ego pro te oro, oravi, &

l.i: orabo: nec dubito quin sim exauditus: sentio enim illud Amen in corde meo.

page.notes: Engraved ornament between the title lines and the lower block, not transcribed. The word INDEX at lower right is a printed section word, shown as a separate line below the main text. Some specks and stains omitted.
